query: Which clinical factors best explain longer visit durations?

per_column.name: condition_category
per_column.rationale: A clinically meaningful grouping axis distinct from department; strongly supports explaining duration differences. Samples map cleanly to source text (preventive_wellness for annual physical, acute_infectious for viral URI, etc.).

per_column.name: multisystem_involvement
per_column.rationale: Complexity proxy plausibly linked to visit length. Mostly grounded, but some readings are debatable: the annual physical labeled two_systems and the MI follow-up labeled two_systems involve some inference not clearly warranted by the text.

per_column.name: clinical_severity
per_column.rationale: Severity is a natural driver of duration and a strong modeling axis. Sample gradings are reasonable readings of the text (low for URI/physical, moderate for MI follow-up).

per_column.name: procedure_performed
per_column.rationale: Whether a procedure occurred is a concrete factor that lengthens visits. not_present values in samples correctly reflect texts with no procedure; well grounded.

per_column.name: imaging_or_diagnostic_workup
per_column.rationale: Diagnostic workup intensity is a plausible duration driver and a good grouping axis. Samples grounded (labs_only for lipid/HbA1c, ecg_holter_echo for echo, advanced_imaging for MRI).

per_column.name: disposition_complexity
per_column.rationale: Disposition correlates with visit complexity/duration. Sample values are sound readings (discharge_routine for URI, discharge_with_followup for MI follow-up).

per_column.name: visit_type
per_column.rationale: Useful axis but partly redundant with condition_category and visit reason; still adds a new/acute-vs-followup distinction relevant to duration. Sample values well grounded.

judge.rationale: The added columns provide multiple genuinely distinct clinical axes (severity, procedures, imaging workup, disposition, condition type) that give real leverage for explaining visit duration, going well beyond the original columns. Values in the row-evidence samples are sound readings of the source text with no clear hallucinations; the weakest link is multisystem_involvement, which occasionally infers system counts not explicitly supported. Overall strong on both necessary conditions.
